```{r functions}
# PARAMETER MAPPING FUNCTION
map_parameter_to_beta <- function(param, study = 1, equation = NULL) {
  if (study == 1) {
    beta_map <- c(
      "eta1" = "beta31",
      "eta2" = "beta32",
      "eta1:eta2" = "beta33",
      "eta1:eta1" = "beta34",
      "eta2:eta2" = "beta35"
    )
  } else if (study == 2) {
    if (equation == "eta4") {
      beta_map <- c(
        "eta1" = "beta41",
        "eta2" = "beta42",
        "eta3" = "beta43",
        "eta1:eta2" = "beta44",
        "eta1:eta3" = "beta45",
        "eta1:eta1" = "beta46",
        "eta2:eta2" = "beta47"
      )
    } else if (equation == "eta5") {
      beta_map <- c(
        "eta1" = "beta51",
        "eta2" = "beta52",
        "eta3" = "beta53",
        "eta4" = "beta54",
        "eta1:eta4" = "beta55",
        "eta2:eta4" = "beta56",
        "eta1:eta1" = "beta57",
        "eta3:eta3" = "beta58"
      )
    }
  }

  ifelse(param %in% names(beta_map), beta_map[param], param)
}

# SIM 1: results tables separated by condition (keeping Methods together)
create_apa_results_table_study1_by_condition <- function(results_df, condition_filter, model_filter,
                                                         distr_exo_filter, distr_epsilon_filter,
                                                         distr_zeta_filter, n_filter, rel_filter) {

  df <- results_df %>%
    filter(
      Condition == condition_filter,
      Model == model_filter,
      Distr_Exo == distr_exo_filter,
      Distr_Epsilon == distr_epsilon_filter,
      Distr_Zeta == distr_zeta_filter,
      SampleSize == n_filter,
      Reliability == rel_filter
    ) %>%
    select(
      Method,
      Parameter,
      TrueValue,
      MeanEstimate,
      Bias_Mean,
      Bias_Mean_MCSE,
      RelativeBias_Mean,
      RelativeBias_MCSE,
      MedianEstimate,
      Bias_Median,
      MAD,
      Variance,
      Variance_MCSE,
      SD,
      SD_MCSE,
      MSE_Mean,
      MSE_Mean_MCSE,
      RMSE_Mean,
      RMSE_Mean_MCSE,
      RMSE_Median,
      Relative_MSE,
      Relative_MSE_MCSE,
      Relative_RMSE,
      Relative_RMSE_MCSE,
      SE_SD_Ratio,
      CoverageRate,
      CoverageRate_MCSE,
      CI_Width,
      CI_Width_MCSE,
      TypeI_Error,
      TypeI_Error_MCSE,
      Power,
      Power_MCSE
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      # map parameter names to beta notation
      Parameter = map_parameter_to_beta(Parameter, study = 1),
      # create combined columns with ± MCSE
      `Bias ± MCSE` = sprintf("%.3f ± %.3f", Bias_Mean, Bias_Mean_MCSE),
      `Rel. Bias ± MCSE` = ifelse(TrueValue == 0, "—",
                                  sprintf("%.3f ± %.3f", RelativeBias_Mean, RelativeBias_MCSE)),
      `Variance ± MCSE` = sprintf("%.3f ± %.3f", Variance, Variance_MCSE),
      `SD ± MCSE` = sprintf("%.3f ± %.3f", SD, SD_MCSE),
      `MSE ± MCSE` = sprintf("%.3f ± %.3f", MSE_Mean, MSE_Mean_MCSE),
      `RMSE ± MCSE` = sprintf("%.3f ± %.3f", RMSE_Mean, RMSE_Mean_MCSE),
      `Rel. MSE ± MCSE` = ifelse(TrueValue == 0, "—",
                                 sprintf("%.3f ± %.3f", Relative_MSE, Relative_MSE_MCSE)),
      `Rel. RMSE ± MCSE` = ifelse(TrueValue == 0, "—",
                                  sprintf("%.3f ± %.3f", Relative_RMSE, Relative_RMSE_MCSE)),
      `Coverage ± MCSE` = sprintf("%.3f ± %.3f", CoverageRate, CoverageRate_MCSE),
      `CI Width ± MCSE` = sprintf("%.3f ± %.3f", CI_Width, CI_Width_MCSE),
      `Type I ± MCSE` = ifelse(is.na(TypeI_Error), "—",
                               sprintf("%.3f ± %.3f", TypeI_Error, TypeI_Error_MCSE)),
      `Power ± MCSE` = ifelse(is.na(Power), "—",
                              sprintf("%.3f ± %.3f", Power, Power_MCSE))
    ) %>%
    select(
      Method, Parameter,
      TrueValue,
      # mean-based columns
      MeanEstimate, `Bias ± MCSE`, `Rel. Bias ± MCSE`,
      `Variance ± MCSE`, `SD ± MCSE`,
      `MSE ± MCSE`, `RMSE ± MCSE`,
      `Rel. MSE ± MCSE`, `Rel. RMSE ± MCSE`,
      # median-based columns
      MedianEstimate, Bias_Median, MAD, RMSE_Median,
      # inference columns
      SE_SD_Ratio,
      `Coverage ± MCSE`, `CI Width ± MCSE`,
      `Type I ± MCSE`, `Power ± MCSE`
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      TrueValue = round(TrueValue, 3),
      MeanEstimate = round(MeanEstimate, 3),
      MedianEstimate = round(MedianEstimate, 3),
      Bias_Median = round(Bias_Median, 3),
      MAD = round(MAD, 4),
      RMSE_Median = round(RMSE_Median, 4),
      SE_SD_Ratio = round(SE_SD_Ratio, 3)
    ) %>%
    arrange(Method, Parameter)

  # remove the unnecessary column based on model type
  if(model_filter == "Full") {
    df <- df %>% select(-`Type I ± MCSE`)
  } else {
    df <- df %>% select(-`Power ± MCSE`)
  }

  df
}

# SIM 2: results tables separated by condition (keeping Methods together)
create_apa_results_table_study2_by_condition <- function(results_df, condition_filter, model_filter,
                                                         distr_exo_filter, distr_epsilon_filter,
                                                         distr_zeta_filter, n_filter, rel_filter) {

  df <- results_df %>%
    filter(
      Condition == condition_filter,
      Model == model_filter,
      Distr_Exo == distr_exo_filter,
      Distr_Epsilon == distr_epsilon_filter,
      Distr_Zeta == distr_zeta_filter,
      SampleSize == n_filter,
      Reliability == rel_filter
    ) %>%
    select(
      Method,
      Equation,
      Parameter,
      TrueValue,
      MeanEstimate,
      Bias_Mean,
      Bias_Mean_MCSE,
      RelativeBias_Mean,
      RelativeBias_MCSE,
      MedianEstimate,
      Bias_Median,
      MAD,
      Variance,
      Variance_MCSE,
      SD,
      SD_MCSE,
      MSE_Mean,
      MSE_Mean_MCSE,
      RMSE_Mean,
      RMSE_Mean_MCSE,
      RMSE_Median,
      Relative_MSE,
      Relative_MSE_MCSE,
      Relative_RMSE,
      Relative_RMSE_MCSE,
      SE_SD_Ratio,
      CoverageRate,
      CoverageRate_MCSE,
      CI_Width,
      CI_Width_MCSE,
      TypeI_Error,
      TypeI_Error_MCSE,
      Power,
      Power_MCSE
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      # map parameter names to beta notation
      Parameter = mapply(map_parameter_to_beta, Parameter, study = 2, equation = Equation),
      # create combined columns with ± MCSE
      `Bias ± MCSE` = sprintf("%.3f ± %.3f", Bias_Mean, Bias_Mean_MCSE),
      `Rel. Bias ± MCSE` = ifelse(TrueValue == 0, "—",
                                  sprintf("%.3f ± %.3f", RelativeBias_Mean, RelativeBias_MCSE)),
      `Variance ± MCSE` = sprintf("%.3f ± %.3f", Variance, Variance_MCSE),
      `SD ± MCSE` = sprintf("%.3f ± %.3f", SD, SD_MCSE),
      `MSE ± MCSE` = sprintf("%.3f ± %.3f", MSE_Mean, MSE_Mean_MCSE),
      `RMSE ± MCSE` = sprintf("%.3f ± %.3f", RMSE_Mean, RMSE_Mean_MCSE),
      `Rel. MSE ± MCSE` = ifelse(TrueValue == 0, "—",
                                 sprintf("%.3f ± %.3f", Relative_MSE, Relative_MSE_MCSE)),
      `Rel. RMSE ± MCSE` = ifelse(TrueValue == 0, "—",
                                  sprintf("%.3f ± %.3f", Relative_RMSE, Relative_RMSE_MCSE)),
      `Coverage ± MCSE` = sprintf("%.3f ± %.3f", CoverageRate, CoverageRate_MCSE),
      `CI Width ± MCSE` = sprintf("%.3f ± %.3f", CI_Width, CI_Width_MCSE),
      `Type I ± MCSE` = ifelse(is.na(TypeI_Error), "—",
                               sprintf("%.3f ± %.3f", TypeI_Error, TypeI_Error_MCSE)),
      `Power ± MCSE` = ifelse(is.na(Power), "—",
                              sprintf("%.3f ± %.3f", Power, Power_MCSE))
    ) %>%
    select(
      Method, Equation, Parameter,
      TrueValue,
      # mean-based columns
      MeanEstimate, `Bias ± MCSE`, `Rel. Bias ± MCSE`,
      `Variance ± MCSE`, `SD ± MCSE`,
      `MSE ± MCSE`, `RMSE ± MCSE`,
      `Rel. MSE ± MCSE`, `Rel. RMSE ± MCSE`,
      # median-based columns
      MedianEstimate, Bias_Median, MAD, RMSE_Median,
      # inference columns
      SE_SD_Ratio,
      `Coverage ± MCSE`, `CI Width ± MCSE`,
      `Type I ± MCSE`, `Power ± MCSE`
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      TrueValue = round(TrueValue, 3),
      MeanEstimate = round(MeanEstimate, 3),
      MedianEstimate = round(MedianEstimate, 3),
      Bias_Median = round(Bias_Median, 3),
      MAD = round(MAD, 4),
      RMSE_Median = round(RMSE_Median, 4),
      SE_SD_Ratio = round(SE_SD_Ratio, 3)
    ) %>%
    arrange(Method, Equation, Parameter)

  # remove the unnecessary column based on model type
  if(model_filter == "Full") {
    df <- df %>% select(-`Type I ± MCSE`)
  } else {
    df <- df %>% select(-`Power ± MCSE`)
  }

  df
}

# Distribution label helper functions
format_distr_exo <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    x == "normal" ~ "Normal",
    x == "nonnormal" ~ "Right-skewed",
    x == "uniform" ~ "Uniform",
    TRUE ~ x
  )
}

format_distr_error <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    x == "normal" ~ "Normal",
    x == "exp.rate1" ~ "Exponential",
    TRUE ~ x
  )
}
```

```{r generate-tables}
# unique condition combinations for sim 1 (excluding method)
conditions_study1 <- results_study_1 %>%
  select(Condition, Model, Distr_Exo, Distr_Epsilon, Distr_Zeta, SampleSize, Reliability) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(
    Distr_Exo_Label = format_distr_exo(Distr_Exo),
    Distr_Epsilon_Label = format_distr_error(Distr_Epsilon),
    Distr_Zeta_Label = format_distr_error(Distr_Zeta)
  ) %>%
  arrange(Condition, factor(Model, levels = c("Full", "Linear")))

# tables for each condition in sim 1
for(i in 1:nrow(conditions_study1)) {
  condition_data <- conditions_study1[i, ]

  # table for this condition (includes all methods)
  condition_table <- create_apa_results_table_study1_by_condition(
    results_study_1,
    condition_data$Condition,
    condition_data$Model,
    condition_data$Distr_Exo,
    condition_data$Distr_Epsilon,
    condition_data$Distr_Zeta,
    condition_data$SampleSize,
    condition_data$Reliability
  )

  tab_caption <- sprintf(
    "Simulation 1 - Condition %s: %s Model, Exogenous = %s, Epsilon = %s, Zeta = %s, N = %d, Reliability = %.1f",
    condition_data$Condition,
    condition_data$Model,
    condition_data$Distr_Exo_Label,
    condition_data$Distr_Epsilon_Label,
    condition_data$Distr_Zeta_Label,
    condition_data$SampleSize,
    condition_data$Reliability
  )

  tab_note <- "MCSE = Monte Carlo Standard Error shown as ± value. Coverage, Type I Error, and Power expressed as percentages. — indicates relative measures are undefined when true value equals 0 and non-existent results for Type I error rate which was evaluated only for nonlinear effects."

  cat("\\setlength{\\tabcolsep}{3pt}\n")

  print(
    kableExtra::kbl(
      condition_table,
      booktabs = TRUE,
      longtable = TRUE,
      align = c("l", "l", rep("r", if(condition_data$Model == "Full") 17 else 17)),
      col.names = c("Method", "Param.",
                    "True",
                    "Mean", "Bias ± MCSE", "Rel. Bias ± MCSE",
                    "Var. ± MCSE", "SD ± MCSE",
                    "MSE ± MCSE", "RMSE ± MCSE",
                    "Rel. MSE ± MCSE", "Rel. RMSE ± MCSE",
                    "Median", "Bias (Med)", "MAD", "RMSE (Med)",
                    "SE/SD",
                    "Cover. (%) ± MCSE", "CI Width ± MCSE",
                    if(condition_data$Model == "Full") "Power (%) ± MCSE" else "Type I (%) ± MCSE"),
      caption = tab_caption,
      linesep = ""
    ) %>%
      kableExtra::add_header_above(c(
        " " = 3,
        "Mean-based" = 9,
        "Median-based" = 4,
        "Inference" = 4
      )) %>%
      kableExtra::kable_styling(
        latex_options = c("hold_position", "repeat_header"),
        font_size = 3.5
      ) %>%
      kableExtra::collapse_rows(columns = 1, valign = "top", latex_hline = "major") %>%
      kableExtra::footnote(
        general = tab_note,
        general_title = "Note.",
        threeparttable = TRUE,
        escape = TRUE
      ) %>%
      kableExtra::landscape()
  )

  cat("\\setlength{\\tabcolsep}{6pt}\n")

  cat("\n\\clearpage\n\n")
}
```
